record_scope_reconstruction: Three named Iraq–Iran road terminals; passengers and cargo have different restoration evidence. Sheeb/Chazabeh and Mandali/Sumar are cross-border aliases, not extra sites.

source_checks.finding: Security Media Cell identifies three posts, September12 closure, September13 passenger restoration at Sheeb and Shalamcheh; other cargo dates are scheduled.
September16 report confirms Shalamcheh trucks resumed and Sumar reopened Tuesday; Sheeb cargo remained closed.
